tooltip.stasisdelvers.lance_core.0: At a rift's rim: stack 3+ Stasis Tower Poles on it, then a boom off the mast's top out over the rift's eye.
tooltip.stasisdelvers.lance_core.1: Use a rift focus on it (charged for End rifts). Needs power (FE, e.g. EA's exporter): ~30-50 kW to breach, 10 kW to hold.
tooltip.stasisdelvers.lance_core.2: The breach shrinks the rift to a quarter, then the gate opens: step into the eye. Right-click: status.
tooltip.stasisdelvers.stasis_tower.0: Place two, one on the other: they form a tower core, which runs a stasis field.
tooltip.stasisdelvers.stasis_tower.1: Needs power (FE, e.g. from EA's exporter) on any face; starts at half a store.
tooltip.stasisdelvers.stasis_tower.2: Stack Stasis Tower Poles on top; booms may start from the core's top block. Right-click: status.
tooltip.stasisdelvers.stasis_tower_segme: Survey pole: stack on the tower core's top centre to raise the mast (a wider field).
Use a pole on the mast to extend it upward; sneak-use on its side to start a boom.
Climbable like scaffolding. The tower takes shape around the poles.
item.stasisdelvers.stability_compass.too: Points to the nearest place of safety
item.stasisdelvers.stability_compass.non: The needle spins: no stillness is spreading here
advancements.stasisdelvers.breaking_it.d: Be in the End when the dragon's death shatters it, and be thrown home by the flash
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.root.d: Ways to die where time stands still.
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.cow.de: Killed by a cow. Nobody will believe you.
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.pig.de: Killed by a pig. It wasn't even a hoglin.
Killed by a sheep. Count yourself out.
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.chicke: Killed by a chicken. Fowl play.
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.puppet: Killed by something a Puppeteer was wearing.
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.self_m: Beaten by your own body. In your own armour.
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.low_ba: Frozen with Static on your back. It was hungry.
